tasks.title: Implement JWT token service
tasks.description: Create a token service that issues signed JWTs with configurable expiry, refresh tokens, and revocation via a deny list. Use HMAC-SHA256 with a server-generated secret or RSA key pair.

tasks.title: Wire session auth into middleware
tasks.description: Replace the TODO stub in auth.go session mode with real JWT validation. Extract claims, map to roles (Admin, Approver, Viewer), and populate request context.

tasks.title: Add login and logout API endpoints
tasks.description: POST /api/auth/login (credentials → JWT + refresh token), POST /api/auth/refresh (refresh → new JWT), POST /api/auth/logout (revoke tokens). Rate-limit login attempts.

tasks.title: Add session auth test coverage
tasks.description: Unit tests for token service (issue, validate, refresh, revoke). Integration tests for login flow, expired tokens, role mapping, and rate limiting. Target 90%+ coverage on auth package.

tasks.title: Add OIDC provider configuration
tasks.description: Extend DashboardAuthConfig with OIDC fields: issuer URL, client ID, client secret, redirect URI, scopes, and claim mappings. Support discovery via .well-known/openid-configuration.

tasks.title: Implement OIDC authorization code flow
tasks.description: Add /api/auth/oidc/login (redirect to IdP), /api/auth/oidc/callback (exchange code for tokens, create session). Validate ID tokens, extract claims, map groups to roles.

tasks.title: Map OIDC claims to Relicta roles
tasks.description: Configurable claim-to-role mapping (e.g., groups claim 'relicta-admins' → Admin role). Support multiple IdPs with independent mappings. Fallback to default Viewer role for unmapped users.

tasks.title: Test OIDC flows and document setup
tasks.description: Integration tests with a mock OIDC provider. Document IdP setup for Okta, Azure AD, and Google Workspace with example configs.

tasks.title: Define persistence port interface
tasks.description: Extract a clean port interface from the file event store adapter. Both file-based and PostgreSQL adapters implement the same interface. Use the repository pattern from the existing hexagonal architecture.

tasks.title: Implement PostgreSQL adapter with sqlc
tasks.description: Implement the persistence port using sqlc for type-safe query generation with pgx as the driver. Store events in an append-only events table with JSONB payload. Add indexes for release ID, timestamp, and event type. Use connection pooling.

tasks.title: Add database migration framework
tasks.description: Embed SQL migrations via go:embed. Support up/down migrations with version tracking. Add relicta db migrate and relicta db status CLI commands. Use golang-migrate or similar.

tasks.title: Add persistence configuration
tasks.description: Extend config schema with persistence section: backend type (file, postgres), connection string (with env var expansion), pool size, migration mode (auto, manual). Wire adapter selection in container setup.

tasks.title: Add persistence layer tests
tasks.description: Unit tests with interface mocks. Integration tests with testcontainers for PostgreSQL. Test migration up/down, concurrent writes, event replay, and failover to file-based when DB is unreachable.

tasks.title: Capture analytics events
tasks.description: Emit structured analytics events for: risk evaluations, policy decisions, approval outcomes, release durations, bump types. Store via the persistence port (file or PostgreSQL).

tasks.title: Add analytics query endpoints
tasks.description: GET /api/analytics/risk-trends (time-series risk scores), GET /api/analytics/decisions (policy decision distribution), GET /api/analytics/team (approvals per actor, release velocity). Support date range and granularity parameters.

tasks.title: Implement analytics aggregation
tasks.description: Pre-aggregate metrics for dashboard performance: daily/weekly/monthly rollups for risk scores, decision counts, release frequency. For file backend, aggregate on read. For PostgreSQL, use materialized views or scheduled aggregation.

tasks.title: Add analytics test coverage
tasks.description: Unit tests for event capture and aggregation logic. Integration tests for query endpoints with seeded data. Verify both file and PostgreSQL backends produce consistent results.

tasks.title: Add API versioning
tasks.description: Prefix all API routes with /api/v1/. Add version negotiation via Accept header. Document versioning policy (additive changes in minor, breaking changes in major).

tasks.title: Add pagination and filtering to list endpoints
tasks.description: Cursor-based pagination for releases, events, and audit trail endpoints. Support limit, cursor, sort, and filter query params. Return Link headers and pagination metadata in response body.

tasks.title: Generate OpenAPI specification
tasks.description: Annotate handlers with OpenAPI metadata. Generate spec at build time or serve at /api/v1/openapi.json. Include authentication schemes, error responses, and example payloads.

tasks.title: Implement structured error responses
tasks.description: Standardize error format: {code, message, details, request_id}. Map domain errors to HTTP status codes consistently. Add request ID middleware for correlation.

tasks.title: Add API contract tests
tasks.description: Integration tests verifying pagination, error formats, versioning, and OpenAPI spec accuracy. Use golden file tests for response shapes. Target full endpoint coverage.

tasks.title: Add persistent webhook delivery queue
tasks.description: Queue webhook deliveries for async processing. Persist pending deliveries so they survive restarts. Process in order per endpoint with configurable concurrency.

tasks.title: Implement retry with exponential backoff
tasks.description: Retry failed deliveries with exponential backoff and jitter. Respect Retry-After headers. Move to dead-letter after max retries. Log all delivery attempts with status codes.

tasks.title: Add webhook delivery log
tasks.description: Log delivery attempts with timestamp, endpoint, status code, response time, and payload hash. Expose via GET /api/v1/webhooks/:id/deliveries. Support manual re-delivery.

tasks.title: Add webhook delivery tests
tasks.description: Unit tests for queue, retry logic, and backoff calculation. Integration tests with httptest server simulating failures, slow responses, and redirects.
